body.text: This is your question for today. Keep it in mind during the games.
Three games tonight: standing, guarded, pinned. Win one and the next round gets harder. Lose it and you run the same one again.
Skill Learning Objective (SLO): Entering, for both players.
Both players stand facing each other, hand fighting range. One is the underhook player, one is the leg player.
Underhook player: hand fight and get one underhook, staying upright. Leg player: hand fight and pick up one leg, connecting both hands around it anywhere from hip to ankle.

items: The underhook player wins with one underhook.
The leg player wins by picking up a leg.

body.text: SLO: Arriving for the top player, Leaving for the bottom player.
The top player stands, fully connected. The bottom player has inside hooks and a knee-pit grip.

Bottom player: stay connected, or get the connection back if it slips. Use it to put the top player on his butt or hands, then stand up and make his back touch the mat. Top player: put the bottom player on his back and fight to the knee pit or the outside, staying on your feet.

items: The bottom player wins by putting the top player down, standing up, and making his back touch the mat, or by wrestling all the way up to a connection.
The top player wins with shin contact at the knee pit or the body from outside.

body.text: Rear Hip Connection, Keep Belly Down
SLO: Controlling for the top player, Leaving for the bottom player.
The defender is on his elbows and knees. The attacker is behind him with his hands locked around the defender's waist.
Attacker: keep the defender belly down, using knee-to-knee and foot-to-foot blocking to pull his hips to the mat. Defender: rise to a quad pod, both knees and both elbows off the floor.

items: The attacker has no time limit. He holds as long as he keeps the defender belly down.
The defender wins by reaching a quad pod.
